response_collection: Manually supplied numbered responses; evaluated as submitted.
scoring: JSON schema validation and exact object match, ignoring key order; required nulls and period tokens must match. No date normalization.

gpt-6-sol.measurement: Client wall-clock time to receive the complete API response, including network time.

gpt-6-luna.measurement: Client wall-clock time to receive the complete API response, including network time.

gpt-4.1-mini.measurement: Client wall-clock time to receive the complete API response, including network time.

mubit-adapter.measurement: User-reported average in the submitted adapter answers; individual timings and sample count not supplied.

latency_comparison.api_timing_provenance: For each API model, 21 timings come from saved request logs; the remaining four are preserved from the earlier completed-run output after the raw files were removed during cleanup.
latency_comparison.comparability: Same 25 question texts for the API models, across separate runs. The adapter average may use different timing boundaries; these are indicative measurements, not a controlled speed benchmark.
